The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Revan/Legends|Darth Revan]] constructed a '''complex''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] where he left the [[Infinite Engine]], a piece of the [[Star Forge]] that was tended by [[Alien/Legends|alien]] slaves. The complex was guarded by enhanced droids and defenses generated by the Infinite Engine, and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] sought to control the facility during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].
